items.description: From experiencing racism growing up in Newcastle to becoming a derby hero and now a member of the executive team, the former striker has been on a remarkable journey“There were times where I feared for my life as a kid, being harassed and chased by different groups of people,” Shola Ameobi says. “There were situations where I had to sprint to get away from groups of lads who didn’t like me because of what I looked like.”Ameobi is recalling growing up in Newcastle during the late 1980s and 1990s, having moved from Nigeria aged six. There were, he says, “lots of moments” like that. “It was almost as if I had to hide myself to be able to do what I love to do. items.title: Florian Thauvin
items.description: Florian Thauvin est un joueur de football français né le 26 janvier 1993 à Orléans. Milieu offensif pouvant jouer ailier, il a été formé à Grenoble, où il a effectué ses début professionnels avant de rejoindre Bastia. C'est en Corse qui aura franchi un cap, avant de rejoindre l'Olympique de Marseille en 2013 après un gros imbroglio avec Lille. Il reviendra à l'OM en 2017, après un passage à Newcastle, avant de tenter l'aventure au Mexique. A l'été 2025, il signe son retour en Ligue 1 en choisissant le RC Lens. International français, il a remporté la Coupe du monde en 2018 avec l'équipe de France.

Perdió 2-0, era la jornada 35 del campeonato y el Barça lograba los puntos que necesitaba para proclamarse campeón de liga por 29ª vez ante su gran rival, felicidad plena.

items.title: Conclusiones en positivo tras el primer KO
items.description: El Barça cayó en París por un claro 4-2 que demuestra que el PSG fue superior al conjunto azulgrana. Sin embargo, yendo al detalle, se puede comprobar que si los franceses fueron mejores en el conjunto del encuentro, el equipo de Flick, con ausencias de peso, mantuvo la cara al partido casi hasta el final y, además, incluso se pudo poner por delante tras el golazo que marcó Xavi Espart para poner el momentáneo 1-1 en el tanteador. Porque puestos a sacar conclusiones de lo visto ante el mejor equipo del mundo, el Barça tiene motivos para pensar que puede competirle en una eliminatoria si cuenta con sus mejores hombres y si logra frenar su hemorragia defensiva en cuanto a goles encajados en Champions League. Algunos puntos para pensar en positivo son los siguientes:

items.title: Expectación máxima en Oviedo por Messi

items.title: La Real visita Noruega con la urgencia de lograr la victoria
items.description: Duelo de campeones de Copa el de esta noche en el Arasen Stadion. El Lillestrom que dirige el padre de Odegaard medirá la capacidad de la Real de afrontar y superar a un rival, a priori, inferior porque juega en una liga menor a la que acaba de ascender además, pero cuando las papas queman, que es diferente que ir a Málaga, a casa del colista, en buena dinámica y yendo sextos. Porque ahora los txuri urdin se la juegan en Europa en territorio nórdico, vikingo, siempre difíciles de asaltar, donde solo jugaron una vez y ganaron, al Rosenborg en 2017, con Odriozola, Oyarzabal y Zubeldia en la plantilla. Dos de ellos podrán repetir triunfo, con otro celebrándolo en el palco, el ahora representante institucional Xabi Prieto. Los dos equipos suman un único punto en dos jornadas de la Europa League y ya tienen díficil pensar en el top 8. Pero en el caso realista una derrota contra un equipo del bombo 4 le metería en serios problemas más allá de eso, con 15 puntos más por jugarse y con Juventus, Crystal Palace o Lyon aún esperando en el calendario.

items.title: Arsenal’s Declan Rice strikes late to deny Bayern Munich after Harry Kane penalty
items.description: It is as if Harry Kane cannot get enough of tormenting Arsenal. The Bayern Munich striker has plenty of form from his Tottenham days. He remains the top scorer in north London derby history with 14 goals. He made an impact yet again here and yet it was not a night when he had the final word. That honour fell to Declan Rice, the Arsenal midfielder storming into the Bayern area in the 82nd minute to guide home a low finish that Kane would have been proud to call his own.Arsenal were hunting their latest statement result. Only once had they ever won away against Bayern – the 2-0 in the Champions League last 16 second leg in 2013, although it did not prevent an away goals exit. Mikel Arteta was an Arsenal player that night. When Eberechi Eze, who came on for the injured Bukayo Saka in the 10th minute, gave them the lead midway through the first half, their hopes surged. items.title: Barkley and Buendía on target as Aston Villa sink Viking to maintain perfect start
items.description: For a little over 20 minutes, Aston Villa could look down on the rest of Europe. They had scaled the Champions League summit on goal difference when Henrik Heggheim put through his own net and the fact was not lost on the Holte End, who reflected their position in song and perhaps allowed themselves another glimpse back to the days when their supremacy was undisputed. “We’ve conquered before, we’re prepared for more,” the pre-match tifo display had read.Perhaps Villa really will rekindle the spirit of 1982 but the frustration here, albeit minor in the wider scheme, was that they could not maintain their bird’s-eye view over the continent. A superbly taken volley by Peter Christiansen, awarded by the video assistant referee after initially being disallowed for offside, gave Viking a consolation their second-half display deserved and meant Unai Emery’s side must make do with slumming it just behind Paris Saint-Germain. items.title: Terzic: "Hemos pasado de controlar el partido a perseguir el resultado"
items.description: Edin Terzic ha tratado de explicar la derrota de su equipo en el Ciutat de Valencia. El Athletic ha comenzado bien, pero las dos pérdidas de balón y los dos goles posteriores del Levante han sido una losa muy difícil de superar. “Hemos tenido el control del partido al principio y hemos creado las primeras ocasiones, pero esas dos perdidas de balón nos ha creado problemas. Nos han marcado dos goles rápidos y hemos pasado de controlar el partido a perseguir el resultado. Eso nos ha llevado a tomar más riesgos”, ha afirmado. Ya en la segunda mitad, ha llegado la roja directa a Laporte. “La expulsión ha sido crucial, pero después hemos creído en nosotros, hemos luchado hasta el final, con un jugador menos hemos peleado y ya con 3-1 ha sido imposible. Se pueden criticar las pérdidas de balón en la medular, lo positivo es que hemos luchado hasta el final. Se puede construir sobre estas cosas”, ha añadido.

items.title: Michael Carrick apologizes to Manchester United fans after humiliating 4-1 Como demolition
items.description:
Manchester United manager Michael Carrick offered a direct apology to traveling supporters and shouldered collective blame after an abject 4-1 Champions League defeat to Italian newcomers Como. 
Manchester United traveled to Italy to face Como 1907 in the 2026–27 UEFA Champions League, only to return to England on the end of a resounding 4–1 defeat that intensifies the scrutiny surrounding head coach Michael Carrick following a difficult run of results.



Matchday 3 proved to be a chastening evening for Manchester United, as the Premier League side was thoroughly outplayed by Cesc Fabregas’ side at the Stadio Giuseppe Sinigaglia. The setback compounded a troubled start to the campaign and placed Carrick under heightened pressure, with the manager walking directly to the travelling supporters at the final whistle to offer an apology for the team’s performance.



“I can only apologise to our fans. No excuses,” Michael Carrick said after the game. “I care an unbelievable amount about the supporters, they’re the heartbeat and always will be.”



Manchester United need a change of direction



The current campaign has proved exceptionally demanding for Manchester United across all fronts. With only one win from three Champions League fixtures, their domestic fortunes are equally concerning: they sit 13th in the Premier League standings, having collected just seven points from a possible 21 to remain uncomfortably close to the relegation places.



Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United)



This heavy loss against Como could prove pivotal not only for Carrick’s immediate job security, but also for the wider club hierarchy and playing squad, both of whom face intense criticism over a string of underwhelming tactical setups and substandard individual displays.


        


Having fought to return to the Champions League this season, failing to qualify for next year’s edition would represent a significant sporting and financial blow. Consistency remains the fundamental challenge for the Red Devils, whose erratic form on the pitch continues to undermine their ability to establish momentum and compete effectively at the highest level of European soccer.

items.title: Why was Bukayo Saka subbed off by Arsenal vs Bayern Munich in the 2026-27 Champions League?
items.description:
Bukayo Saka was substituted off early against Bayern Munich after appearing to hurt his left knee while making a pass. 
Bukayo Saka was substituted off by Arsenal early in the Champions League match against Bayern Munich at the Allianz Arena, and the reason appears to be an injury to his left knee.



The England winger went down in the opening minutes after appearing to hurt himself while making a pass. Replays showed that he did not make full contact with the ball, and Saka needed medical attention on the pitch before it became clear he could not continue.



Saka was replaced by Eberechi Eze, who took his place in the attacking line alongside Martin Odegaard and Noni Madueke, behind Kai Havertz. The change forced Mikel Arteta to rethink his plan early in a demanding away match against one of Europe’s strongest teams.



The setback is a major concern for Arteta at a crucial moment. Arsenal arrive in Munich with a perfect record in the competition, after a 1-0 win over Napoli and a 3-0 win over Lille, and they are the only team yet to concede in this season’s league phase. Saka has been one of the team’s key attackers, and the extent of the injury will be closely watched in the coming days.



pic.twitter.com/TohtAZMfIQ— TopCee (@TopceeX) October 21, 2026 



First injury concern of the season for Saka



The scare against Bayern is Saka’s first injury setback of the 2026-27 campaign. Last season, the winger missed 11 matches across all competitions, according to Transfermarkt, because of three separate problems: a hamstring injury in August and September, a hip issue in January and February, and an Achilles problem in April.


        


The Achilles injury was the most serious, as it kept him out of five matches in a decisive stretch. Saka missed Arsenal’s FA Cup quarterfinal, both legs of their Champions League quarterfinal against Sporting, and Premier League matches against Bournemouth and Manchester City. He returned in time to play in the Champions League semifinals and in the final against PSG on May 30, a defeat on penalties.



Arsenal are expected to provide an update on Saka’s condition in the coming hours. Until then, Mikel Arteta may have to plan for the coming weeks without one of his key attackers.

items.title: Why is Luis Diaz not starting for Bayern Munich vs Arsenal in 2026-27 UEFA Champions League?
items.description:
Luis Diaz is not in the starting lineup for Bayern Munich as the Bundesliga champions host Arsenal in one of the biggest games of the Champions League league phase, and the reason appears to be a tactical decision by Vincent Kompany. The Colombian winger starts on the bench despite scoring a hat trick in the […] 
Luis Diaz is not in the starting lineup for Bayern Munich as the Bundesliga champions host Arsenal in one of the biggest games of the Champions League league phase, and the reason appears to be a tactical decision by Vincent Kompany.



The Colombian winger starts on the bench despite scoring a hat trick in the 6-1 win over RB Leipzig on Oct. 17. Bayern have not reported any injury or suspension for Diaz, and Kompany has not explained the decision, so it looks like a choice made for tactical reasons.



In his place, Kompany decided to start Alphonso Davies on the left wing, behind Harry Kane. The attack will look very different from the one that took the field in the 3-3 draw against Viking on the previous matchday, as Michael Olise is suspended and unavailable for this match.



Kompany’s decision to leave Diaz on the bench can be read as a more defensive approach. With Davies in his place on the left, Bayern gain a player who can help in defense against the attacks of Bukayo Saka and Jurrien Timber.




Our starting XI for tonight! 🌟 pic.twitter.com/w87KMd9LqP— FC Bayern (@FCBayernEN) October 21, 2026




Lineups confirmed



Without Joshua Kimmich and Olise, Vincent Kompany has gone with Bischof and Pavlovic in midfield. Manuel Neuer starts in goal despite being a doubt with a foot issue, while Davies, Gnabry and Saibari support Harry Kane in attack.


        


Bayern confirmed lineup: Neuer (C); Laimer, Upamecano, Min-jae Kim, Stanisic; Bischof, Pavlovic; Gnabry, Saibari, Davies; Kane.



Arteta has gone with Kai Havertz as his lone striker, leaving Viktor Gyokeres on the bench alongside Mikel Merino. Noni Madueke starts on the right wing alongside Bukayo Saka, with Eberechi Eze among the substitutes, while Jurrien Timber returns at right back.



Arsenal confirmed lineup: Raya; Timber, Gabriel, Konsa, Calafiori; Rice, Bruno Guimaraes; Saka, Odegaard (C), Madueke; Havertz.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo warned national team comeback could trigger fresh problems as ex-Portugal boss sets out return conditions
items.description:
As debate continues over his fallout with head coach Jorge Jesus, a former Portugal manager has warned that the next step could prove crucial to preventing another damaging confrontation. 
Cristiano Ronaldo’s future with Portugal remains uncertain despite the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF)’s decision to impose a backdated suspension that could allow him to return for November’s Nations League fixtures. As debate continues over his fallout with head coach Jorge Jesus, a former Portugal manager has warned that the next step could prove crucial to preventing another damaging confrontation.



The 41-year-old Al-Nassr forward received a 30-day ban and a €255 ($286) fine after leaving Portugal’s training camp in Copenhagen in September. Although the punishment has largely run its course, Coelho believes the federation must handle the captain’s potential return carefully if it wants to avoid reopening the dispute.



Speaking to Radio Renascença’s Bola Branca, Humberto Coelho backed the decision to suspend Ronaldo but criticized the financial penalty as ineffective. “Ronaldo’s suspension was important, but the fine is a bit out of place and doesn’t help at all,” the former Selecao manager said.



Coelho also argued that the incident should never have escalated to the point where disciplinary action became necessary. “What I know for sure is that if I were the coach, this wouldn’t have happened. That’s for sure. And if I were a player, I don’t think it would have happened either,” he explained.









As a former national team captain himself, Coelho believes the episode reflects a breakdown in responsibility on multiple sides. He described the situation as complicated and expressed concern about the damage it could cause to both Ronaldo and the FPF.



How Ronaldo’s dispute with Jorge Jesus escalated



The controversy began during the national team’s September international window, when Ronaldo was an unused substitute in the national team’s 2-1 victory over Norway. The forward later claimed that Jesus had given him assurances about his involvement before deciding against using him.



Ronaldo subsequently left Portugal’s camp on September 30, ahead of the Nations League match against Denmark. In a public statement, he accused Jesus of an “absolute breach of trust,” while the coach denied that the two had made the agreement Ronaldo described.



Cristiano Ronaldo #7 of Portugal reacts



The FPF disciplinary council eventually found Ronaldo guilty of an offence under Article 160(1) of its disciplinary regulations. On October 19, the federation announced a 30-day suspension and a symbolic monetary fine, taking into account mitigating circumstances that included Ronaldo’s contributions to football and his recent disciplinary record.



The conditions Ronaldo must meet before returning



Coelho made clear that he would welcome Ronaldo back to Portugal, but stressed that the return must be properly prepared. He believes responsibility cannot rest solely on the player, with the national team coach and federation president also needing to help rebuild trust. “I’d like him to return. The right conditions have to be in place, and that’s up to the coach, the president and Cristiano,” Coelho said.



Pedro Proenca, Cristiano Ronaldo, and Jorge Jesus



He added that the three parties must establish genuine understanding and accept responsibility for their respective roles in resolving the dispute. A return without proper preparation and shared accountability could create further problems rather than settle the existing tensions.



Coelho delivered his strongest warning when discussing what might happen if the situation is mishandled. “If his return isn’t properly planned and prepared, with a strong sense of responsibility from everyone involved, there’s no point in it. Otherwise, serious problems could resurface.”

items.title: Is Vinicius Junior playing today? Confirmed lineups for Real Madrid vs RB Leipzig in 2026-27 UEFA Champions League Matchday 3
items.description:
Take a look at the projected lineups for Real Madrid vs RB Leipzig in the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League Matchday 3 and if Vinicius Junior will play today. Real Madrid host RB Leipzig at the Santiago Bernabeu in the 2026-27 Champions League, with both sides arriving off wins in their most recent outing.
Real Madrid enter on a run of good form. They beat Roma 4-3 on October 14 and followed up a strong September result, a 2-1 win over Inter on September 8. A win here would extend that momentum and strengthen their position in the competition.
RB Leipzig have been inconsistent lately. They edged PSV 1-0 on October 13, but that result came after a 1-4 loss to Como 1907 on September 10. A positive result in Madrid would go a long way toward steadying their campaign.
Real Madrid confirmed lineup
Jose Mourinho sets Real Madrid up in a 4-2-3-1 with Thibaut Courtois behind a back four of Denzel Dumfries, Ibrahima Konate, Antonio Rudiger and Marc Cucurella. Federico Valverde and Aurelien Tchouameni sit in midfield, with Arda Guler operating behind Kylian Mbappe and Vinicius Junior, who is expected to start, in attack alongside Jude Bellingham further forward. There are no listed absences, so Mourinho has his full squad to choose from for this one.
Real Madrid confirmed starting XI (4-2-3-1): Thibaut Courtois, Federico Valverde, Álvaro Carreras, Bernardo Silva, Dean Huijsen, Antonio Rüdiger, Arda Güler, Eduardo Camavinga, Kylian Mbappé, Jude Bellingham, Vinícius Júnior. Coach: José Mário dos Santos Mourinho Félix.
RB Leipzig confirmed lineup
Martin Demichelis also lines RB Leipzig up in a 4-2-3-1, with Maarten Vandevoordt in goal behind Ridle Baku, Willi Orban, Castello Lukeba and David Raum. Neil El Aynaoui and Ezechiel Banzuzi anchor the midfield, while Christopher Nkunku and Brajan Gruda support Romulo and Antonio Nusa in the final third. RB Leipzig have no reported absences, giving Demichelis his preferred group to work with on the road.
RB Leipzig confirmed starting XI (4-2-3-1): Maarten Vandevoordt, Ridle Baku, David Raum, Nicolas Seiwald, Willi Orbán, Castello Lukeba, Brajan Gruda, Neil El Aynaoui, Rômulo, Christopher Nkunku, Antonio Nusa. Coach: Martín Demichelis.

El entrenador lo ha explicado en las cámaras de Movistar antes de comenzar el choque a las 20 horas. El gasteiztarra ya fue el elegido hace un mes cuando se suspendió el partido por las fuertes precipitaciones caídas sobre Valencia. “Maroan iba a tener la oportunidad de ser titular, así que hoy decidimos lo mismo. Creo que tuvo un buen impacto cuando entró el sábado (ante el Valencia). Aunque Guruzeta y Maroan ocupan la misma posición, tienen perfiles totalmente distintos: Maroan es un jugador muy físico al que le gusta estar dentro del área, está atento al primer palo en los centros y aguantando el balón. Iñaki nos da buenos momentos en la presión y buenas demarcaciones al espacio. Ambos son importantes y ambos lo serán hoy, pero hoy elegimos que Maroan sea el titular e Iñaki el revulsivo desde el banquillo”, ha afirmado sobre el capitán.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo’s Portugal fine mocked as Spanish Journalist spots one hilarious double-standards detail
items.description:
The punishment has attracted attention far beyond Portugal, with a Spanish journalist delivering a sarcastic assessment that has sparked amusement and raised questions about the severity of the decision. 
Cristiano Ronaldo has found himself at the center of another international soccer controversy after the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF) announced disciplinary action against the legendary forward. However, the punishment has attracted attention far beyond Portugal, with a Spanish journalist delivering a sarcastic assessment that has sparked amusement and raised questions about the severity of the decision.



The Al-Nassr captain received a suspension following his departure from Portugal’s national team camp ahead of a Nations League fixture against Denmark in September. While the ruling could have consequences for his relationship with national team coach Jorge Jesus, it was one particular aspect of the punishment that prompted Juanma Castano’s most memorable response.



The FPF’s Disciplinary Council handed Ronaldo a 30-day suspension and a €255 ($286) fine after he left the national team camp before Portugal’s Nations League match against Denmark in Copenhagen on September 30. According to the disciplinary ruling, Ronaldo informed federation president Pedro Proenca that he was “not in the right frame of mind to remain with the squad.”



The forward reportedly left Parken Stadium in a vehicle requested through the federation’s director of services as Portugal prepared for a training session. The decision followed a disagreement between Ronaldo and Jesus over the forward’s involvement in the Selecao’s matches. Ronaldo subsequently accused the coach of breaking promises about his playing time and failing to deliver a public clarification they had reportedly agreed upon.



Cristiano Ronaldo of Portugal.



In a statement released on October 6, Ronaldo criticized what he described as Jesus’s “authoritarian, ‘I’m in charge here’ attitude.” The dispute has raised questions about whether the two will be able to move forward together, although the suspension’s timing could allow Ronaldo to return for Portugal’s November fixtures.



Hilarious comparison emerges



Speaking on Spanish radio programme El Partidazo de COPE, Juanma Castano reacted sarcastically to the FPF’s decision, suggesting that the federation had been particularly severe with Ronaldo in one respect while barely affecting him financially.



“The Portuguese Federation isn’t messing around. They’ve slapped him with a 30-day suspension—even though he hasn’t been called up—but the suspension counts from the previous training camp, from the very day he left,” Castano said.



        View this post on Instagram            




He explained that the suspension had effectively been running since the incident, meaning Ronaldo could become eligible for Portugal’s next squad selection once the sanction expires. The journalist then turned his attention to the financial penalty, setting up the punchline that made his comments stand out.



“But they did hit him where it hurts—in his wallet. That’s where they decided to get serious: the ‘cash.’ Cristiano has been fined 255 euros,” Castano joked. He followed with the comparison that quickly became the defining moment of his reaction: “Damn, in any Spanish city, you’d get a 300-euro fine just for taking the trash out at the wrong time—that’s more expensive than deserting the Portuguese national team!”



What helped reduce the punishment



The disciplinary ruling also revealed that Ronaldo’s representatives requested mitigating circumstances based on his contributions to soccer, his sporting achievements and his assistance in establishing the facts of the case. The FPF accepted the arguments relating to his significant service to soccer and his sporting merits, but rejected the claim that he had made a decisive contribution to uncovering the truth.



Cristiano Ronaldo of Portugal holds the UEFA Nations League trophy 



The committee explained that this particular mitigating factor applied to disciplinary cases that were difficult to investigate. The decision has also attracted ridicule beyond Spain, with an English BBC panel reportedly questioning the modest size of the fine and joking about Ronaldo submitting his sporting résumé as part of his defence.

items.title: Julian Alvarez joins Lionel Messi among Argentina’s all-time top Champions League scorers
items.description:
Julian Alvarez ended a 174-day goal drought and joined Lionel Messi among Argentina’s top Champions League scorers. 
Julian Alvarez has joined Lionel Messi among the most prolific Argentine scorers in Champions League history. The Atletico Madrid striker scored in the 1-1 draw at Stuttgart, ending a long scoring drought and lifting his career total in the competition to 26 goals.



Atletico Madrid went into the break trailing after Leweling put Stuttgart ahead in the 36th minute. Alvarez answered early in the second half, finishing a cross from Lookman first time into the top corner in the 47th minute, scoring his first goal of the season for Atletico.



The goal also ended the longest drought of Alvarez’s career. He had not scored since Apr. 29, when he found the net in the 1-1 draw against Arsenal in last season’s Champions League semifinal, a gap of 174 days.



Coach Diego Simeone was full of praise for his forward after the match, especially for the effort he put in on the night. “The game he played was with incredible physical effort,” Simeone said. “He worked parts of the match as an inside forward on the left. The goal was a golazo and it makes me very happy for him, we need him.”




⚽️🕷️ pic.twitter.com/I45FXUEbqV— Atlético de Madrid (@Atleti) October 20, 2026




The Atletico Madrid manager also stressed how important the World Cup winner is to his team. Simeone described Alvarez as “decisive in getting to the places we need to reach” and made a request: “Let’s hope that little by little he starts to find himself again with what he showed us today”.


        


Alvarez moves into elite company



With the goal, Alvarez moved past Hernan Crespo, who sits on 25, and now ranks among the top five Argentine scorers in Champions League history. Only Messi, Alfredo Di Stefano, Sergio Aguero and Lautaro Martinez have scored more.



PlayerGoals1. Lionel Messi1292. Alfredo Di Stefano493. Sergio Aguero414. Lautaro Martinez275. Julian Alvarez266. Hernan Crespo25



Alvarez will now try to build on his goal as Atletico Madrid look to turn their Champions League campaign around. With four points from three matches, the team will need its forward at his best, and the numbers suggest he is on his way to climbing even higher on Argentina’s all-time list.

items.title: Como 1907 vs Manchester United: Confirmed lineups for the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League match
items.description:
Take a look at the projected lineups for Como 1907 vs Manchester United in the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League. Como 1907 host Manchester United in a Champions League clash that pits Cesc Fabregas against Michael Carrick in only the Italian side’s latest European test at this level.
Como lost 2-3 to Feyenoord on October 14 after a 4-1 win over LEIP back on September 10. The mixed results leave them looking to find consistency at home, and a result here would be a significant marker in their first Champions League campaign in decades.
Manchester United fell 0-2 to Atlético on October 13, a step back after beating Sabah FK 4-0 on September 10. They need a response on the road to keep their group-stage push on track, and this trip to Como carries real weight for their European standing.
Como 1907 confirmed lineup
Fabregas sets Como up in a 4-2-3-1 with Jean Butez in goal behind a back four of Yan Couto, Alberto Dossena, Jacobo Ramon and Alex Valle. Luis Milla and Lucas Da Cunha sit in midfield behind Nico Paz, who operates just in front of them as the creative hub, flanked by Martin Baturina and Kaiki, with Anastasios Douvikas leading the line. There are no listed absences, so Fabregas can call on his full projected XI and lean on Paz to dictate tempo against a well-organized United side.
Como 1907 confirmed starting XI (4-2-3-1): Jean Butez, Marc Kempf, Yan Couto, Jacobo Ramon, Alex Valle, Luis Milla, Nico Paz, Lucas Da Cunha, Martin Baturina, Anastasios Douvikas, Maximo Perrone. Coach: Cesc Fabregas.
Manchester United confirmed lineup
Carrick lines Manchester United up in a matching 4-2-3-1, with Senne Lammens behind a back four of Noussair Mazraoui, Harry Maguire, Ayden Heaven and Diogo Dalot. Andrey Santos and Youri Tielemans anchor midfield, with Bruno Fernandes pushed forward as the attacking midfielder alongside Carlos Baleba, Bryan Mbeumo and Matheus Cunha up top. With no absences listed, Carrick has his strongest available group to work with, and the shape should allow Fernandes and Cunha freedom to combine against a Como side playing at home.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo sends emotional message to Kvaratskhelia after PSG winger’s ACL injury
items.description:
Cristiano Ronaldo sent an emotional message to Kvaratskhelia after the PSG winger tore his ACL against Barcelona. 
Cristiano Ronaldo has reached out to Khvicha Kvaratskhelia after the PSG winger suffered a season-ending injury. The Al Nassr star sent a message of support to Kvaratskhelia, who tore his ACL in PSG’s 4-2 Champions League win over Barcelona.



The Portuguese star left a heartfelt message of encouragement for the Georgian in a comment on the post in which the PSG player announced his diagnosis after the injury against Barcelona.



“The hardest battles in football are often ones nobody sees,” Cristiano wrote. “I know that feeling, Kvara. But never forget what brought you this far, and don’t let a difficult moment make you doubt how far you can go. Keep that fire on. Your best is still to come”.



The words carry extra weight because of who they come from. Kvaratskhelia has made it clear on several occasions that Ronaldo is his childhood idol. The two shared a moment at Euro 2024, when Georgia beat Portugal 2-0 and Kvaratskhelia swapped shirts with his hero. Now, at the lowest point of his career, that same idol has told him that his best is still to come.



Cristiano Ronaldo shakes hands with Khvicha Kvaratskhelia during the Euro 2024. (Getty Images)



When could Kvaratskhelia return?



PSG have not put a timeline on Kvaratskhelia’s recovery, and the club only confirmed that he will undergo surgery in the coming days. A rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament typically keeps players out for around nine months, and projections suggest that a return could come around July 2027. That would likely rule him out for the rest of the 2026-27 season, including the decisive stretch of the Champions League and Ligue 1.


        


The injury is a major setback for a player who had played 11 times for PSG this season and was making his first start of the campaign in the Champions League when he went down.



Apart from the Georgian, PSG also suffered injuries to Ousmane Dembele and Marquinhos in the match against Barcelona. The forward sustained a left thigh injury while the defender picked up a right thigh injury, and both join Nuno Mendes on the French side’s injury list.



With Kvaratskhelia out for a long spell and three more key players sidelined, PSG will have to lean on their depth as they try to defend their Champions League crown.

items.title: PSG suffer triple injury blow after Champions League win over Barcelona as Kvaratskhelia tears ACL
items.description:
PSG beat Barcelona 4-2, but Kvaratskhelia tore his ACL while Dembele and Marquinhos also went down injured. 
PSG picked up a huge result, but it may have come at a heavy price. The reigning Champions League winners beat Barcelona 4-2 at the Parc des Princes to stay perfect in the competition, yet three of their key players left the pitch with injuries. The most serious blow is Khvicha Kvaratskhelia’s, who will miss a long stretch of the season.



The club confirmed that Kvaratskhelia suffered a rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament in his right knee. He went down early in the second half after a challenge with Barcelona’s Xavi Espart and could not put any weight on his leg as he was helped off.



PSG confirmed he will undergo surgery in the coming days and did not give a timetable for his return. The 25-year-old was making his first start of the season in the Champions League and has played 11 times for the club this campaign.



Kvaratskhelia reacted to the news on social media. “Why me? I was not ready for this,” he wrote, before promising to come back stronger for the fans who support him.




❤️‍🩹 Khvicha Kvaratskhelia: “Why me? I was not ready for this”.“Many people have asked me questions about this setback, many have said that if all the footballers in the world prayed, the match would end in a draw. That might be true, but before every match I play, I ask God to… pic.twitter.com/nmWiZVdbbg— Fabrizio Romano (@FabrizioRomano) October 21, 2026




Despite losing one of their stars for the rest of the season, the night still ended in celebration for PSG. The game was level at 2-2 heading into the final 10 minutes, and the hosts scored twice late to keep their Champions League defense on track with three wins from three.


        


Dembele, Marquinhos and Mendes join the injury list



Ousmane Dembele and Marquinhos were also forced off against Barcelona. PSG announced that Dembele has a left thigh injury and Marquinhos a right thigh injury, and both “will remain under treatment for the next few weeks”.



While the club did not specify exact return dates for either player, neither is expected to be available for the next Ligue 1 match on Oct. 25, when PSG face Lyon.



The list of absentees was already growing before the match. Nuno Mendes suffered a left thigh injury against Strasbourg on Oct. 17 and was ruled out for the next few weeks, which means he will not be available for the trip to Lyon either. 



With Mendes, Dembele and Marquinhos all sidelined alongside Kvaratskhelia, PSG will have to rotate heavily across defense and attack in the coming fixtures.

items.title: Manchester City have been a joy to watch but they became detached from their roots | Philipp Lahm
items.description: City behaved much like other top clubs but their rule-breaking deserves to be punished. The Bundesliga, where members have a controlling stake, can show the way forwardDo we have to reassess Manchester City now? In my columns, I have repeatedly engaged with this club and its key figures. Looking back at what I have written over the years, I believe it remains beyond question that the team have achieved greatness. I always loved watching them: they were a true unit on the pitch, a finely tuned orchestra.I would also write all over again that the conductor, Pep Guardiola, masters his craft like few others. I could recognise his teams even if they were wearing the wrong shirts and the game was broadcast in black and white – by the passes, the distances between the players and the intelligence of their interplay. It is no wonder Guardiola inspires others to become managers; look at Vincent Kompany, Mikel Arteta, Enzo Maresca, and perhaps some time Ilkay Gündogan and Rodri. Continue reading...

items.title: Raphinha brushes aside 4-2 PSG defeat as Barcelona shift focus to El Clasico vs Real Madrid
items.description:
Barcelona suffered their first defeat of the 2026–27 campaign on Tuesday night, falling 4–2 to defending European champions Paris Saint-Germain in a pulsating UEFA Champions League encounter at the Parc des Princes. 
Barcelona’s unbeaten run came to an end at the worst possible time, falling to Paris Saint-Germain just days before they face Real Madrid in La Liga for El Clásico—a match that could dramatically reshape the season for both sides.



Raphinha returned to Barcelona’s starting lineup following an injury that had sidelined him in recent weeks. While the winger acknowledged that the defeat against PSG arrived at a terrible time, he emphasized that the squad cannot afford to lose focus ahead of Sunday’s crucial showdown against Real Madrid.



“We’ve only lost three points. Now we need to be ready for El Clásico. Focus,” Raphinha said after the game. Hansi Flick supported his statements by sharing that they are now preparing for the duel against Real Madrid.



A reality check



Remaining unbeaten throughout an entire season is practically impossible, especially given the grueling schedule and fierce competition top clubs face across multiple tournaments. Barcelona’s winning streak concluded after 11 consecutive victories, but this reality check may ultimately be exactly what the squad needed.



Raphinha of FC Barcelona waves to the fans as he warms up



Suffering a defeat before El Clásico could prove beneficial for Barcelona. By absorbing a difficult loss against elite opposition, they can now clearly identify the tactical flaws that require immediate attention, helping them prevent another setback against their arch-rivals in a fixture that always carries massive ramifications for both clubs’ campaigns.


        


While PSG are widely regarded as one of the most formidable teams in world football today—presenting a very different challenge than Real Madrid’s current setup—El Clásico operates under its own laws. It remains a fiercely contested, high-intensity encounter where recent form often matters little, as both clubs routinely elevate their performances to avoid defeat in such a pivotal clash.



Barcelona made key mistakes against PSG



PSG boast one of the most dangerous attacks in Europe, meaning no team can afford complacency against them. Unfortunately for Barcelona, careless turnovers and loose distribution proved costly, leaving their back line repeatedly exposed to the French side’s clinical forwards.



This defeat must be taken very seriously by Hansi Flick. With Real Madrid’s attack gaining significant momentum in recent weeks and the defense standing out as Barcelona’s most vulnerable area amid recent injuries, tightening the back line is essential ahead of Sunday.

items.title: Lionel Messi is three games away from matching the longest goal contribution streak of his career
items.description:
Lionel Messi has scored or assisted in 14 straight games and is three matches away from tying the longest such streak of his career. 
Lionel Messi is not slowing down. At 39, the Inter Miami captain is in the middle of a run that is starting to look like one of the best of his career, and the next few weeks could put it into the record books.



Messi has scored or assisted in each of his last 14 games, a streak that began on Aug. 15 with an assist in a 4-1 win at Nashville. It includes 12 straight MLS matches, as well as two special nights outside the league.



On Sept. 16, he scored his 100th goal for Inter Miami and assisted Casemiro’s goal in a 2-0 win over Cruz Azul in the Campeones Cup final, while on Oct. 6, in his farewell match for Argentina, he scored a penalty and set up two goals in a 3-0 win over Benin.



In total, Messi has 15 goals and eight assists during the run, and his latest performance came on Oct. 17, when he scored a brace in a 3-1 victory at Atlanta United to reach 25 goals this season in MLS.




Every touch deserves a replay. Our 10 in Atlanta. 🪄🔄 pic.twitter.com/83jvwLJgCW— Inter Miami CF (@InterMiamiCF) October 18, 2026




The only longer streak in his career dates back to 2011, when he scored 18 goals and provided nine assists over 17 consecutive official games with Barcelona, which means he needs three more matches to tie it.


        


The chance to do it is close at hand. Inter Miami still have four games left in the regular season, starting with visits to Red Bull New York and the New England Revolution, as well as a home match against FC Cincinnati. If Messi contributes in each of them, he will match his career-best mark, and a goal or an assist against Charlotte FC on Nov. 7, on the final day of the regular season, would give him a new record.



Breaking down Messi’s hot streak with Miami



It all started on Aug. 15 at Nashville, where Messi set up a goal in a 4-1 win over the team that is now running away with the Supporters’ Shield. Since then, he has scored 13 goals and provided five assists in 12 straight MLS matches, and he has done it in every way imaginable.



He scored in eight of them and assisted in five, with some nights bigger than others: four goals in the 7-1 rout of CF Montreal, a goal and an assist in the 2-2 draw with Nashville, and a brace in the 4-0 win over D.C. United.



Whether or not Messi breaks the record, the timing could not be better for Inter Miami. The defending MLS Cup champions are heading into the playoffs with their captain in the form of his life. For a team that can no longer chase the Supporters’ Shield, Messi’s run is the best reason to believe they can defend their title.

items.title: Ousmane Dembele forced off early in PSG’s Champions League clash vs. Barcelona: What happened to the forward?
items.description:
Paris Saint-Germain forward Ousmane Dembele was forced off with an apparent muscular issue during the opening half-hour of PSG’s high-stakes UEFA Champions League clash against his former club, FC Barcelona. 
Inside the opening 20 minutes of Tuesday’s UEFA Champions League clash against Barcelona, Paris Saint-Germain were forced into an unexpected early substitution after Ousmane Dembele suffered an apparent muscular injury.



During a swift PSG counter-attack in the 18th minute, the French international executed a sharp change of direction to bypass Barcelona’s defensive line before abruptly pulling up. Dembele immediately clutched the back of his left thigh in visible discomfort and signaled to the bench that he was unable to continue.



Unable to finish the first half, Dembele was officially withdrawn in the 19th minute. PSG head coach Luis Enrique turned to Ferran Torres—another former Barcelona forward—calling on the Spanish international to enter the fray against his ex-club after finding regular playing time hard to come by since his transfer to Paris.



PSG prove formidable even without Dembele



Following Dembele’s early withdrawal, Paris Saint-Germain sustained their offensive pressure even without their primary attacking outlet on the pitch. The Parisian side generated multiple clear scoring opportunities against goalkeeper Joan Garcia before finally breaking the deadlock shortly before the interval.



Ousmane Dembele of Paris Saint-Germain celebrates scoring a goal.



In the 38th minute, Desire Doue collected possession outside Barcelona’s penalty area and unleashed an unstoppable drive past Garcia to open the scoring, demonstrating that PSG’s frontline possesses immense collective depth beyond any single individual.


        


As of now, the full extent of Ousmane Dembele’s injury and his expected recovery timeline remain unconfirmed. However, manager Luis Enrique is anticipated to exercise extreme caution to avoid exacerbating any muscular damage, leaning on Ferran Torres to fill the vacancy on the right wing.

items.title: Why is Erling Haaland not starting for Manchester City against AEK in 2026-27 UEFA Champions League?
items.description:
Erling Haaland is missing from Manchester City’s starting lineup against AEK Athens in the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League, leaving supporters wondering about the decision ahead of a crucial European fixture. 
Erling Haaland is missing from Manchester City’s starting lineup against AEK Athens in the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League, leaving supporters wondering about the decision ahead of a crucial European fixture. After scoring twice in City’s weekend victory over Ipswich Town, the Norwegian striker had been expected to feature. However, Enzo Maresca has made a significant decision regarding his involvement at the Etihad Stadium.



The decision to leave Haaland out comes as Manchester City seek a response in Europe after suffering a 4-2 defeat to Paris Saint-Germain in its previous Champions League match. Despite that setback, the Citizens remain in strong domestic form, having won their first seven Premier League matches of the season.



On the other hand, AEK Athens arrives at the Etihad after losing 3-1 to Shakhtar Donetsk in their previous European outing. The Greek outfit will hope to exploit any uncertainty in City’s lineup, although its record against English opposition and lack of away victories in the Champions League league phase make the challenge particularly difficult.



The reason for Haaland’s absence revealed



Haaland’s absence from the starting XI follows a physical issue he picked up during Manchester City’s 3-2 Premier League win over Ipswich Town on Saturday. The striker scored twice but appeared to be limping late in the match after a challenge involving Ipswich substitute Jack Clarke.



Haaland with a heavy limp as he goes off at full-time. He got a bang on the foot and was likely to be rested on Tuesday, so City will be hoping he’ll be back for Villa next Saturday. Semenyo limping too as he goes off pic.twitter.com/Rhe7tfjJ6Y— Sam Lee (@SamLee) October 17, 2026



Maresca initially offered cautious optimism about the forward’s condition, leaving open the possibility that he could feature against the Greek side. Speaking before the game, the Manchester City manager said: “He can be available, we will see, we have a session now. We have some doubts after Sunday’s game. He was quite good yesterday, better. So we will see today.”



However, the Norway international was ultimately left out of the starting lineup, with City opting against risking its leading goalscorer from the opening whistle. The decision comes during a demanding stretch of fixtures, with Maresca also needing to manage his squad ahead of the upcoming Premier League trip to Aston Villa.



Manchester City boss Enzo Maresca says Erling Haaland could be available against AEK Athens but Antoine Semenyo is “probably out for eight weeks” ⤵️ pic.twitter.com/8yKO7UNy4h— Sky Sports News (@SkySportsNews) October 19, 2026



Haaland’s absence does not necessarily rule him out completely



With Haaland not starting, 17-year-old Floyd Samba has been selected to lead Manchester City’s attack. The young forward previously made an impressive impression by scoring twice on his senior debut during City’s 5-0 Carabao Cup victory over Norwich City. Samba’s inclusion gives the teenager an opportunity to demonstrate that he can contribute at the highest level, although replacing Haaland’s goalscoring output will be a considerable challenge.



Although the 26-year-old striker has not been deemed ready to start, his absence from the starting XI does not automatically mean he will miss the entire match. His availability will depend on his fitness and whether Maresca believes he can contribute without risking further aggravation.

items.title: Is Raphinha playing today? Confirmed lineups for PSG vs Barcelona in 2026-27 UEFA Champions League Matchday 3
items.description:
Take a look at the projected lineups for PSG vs Barcelona in the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League and if Raphinha will start for the Blaugranas. PSG host Barcelona in a Champions League meeting between two sides that have barely put a foot wrong this season, and the Parc des Princes should be rocking for it.
PSG won 4-2 against Man City on October 14, a result that followed a 6-1 rout of Slovan back on September 9. Those two wins have PSG playing with real confidence heading into this stage of the competition. A positive result here would further cement their status as one of the teams to beat in this year’s Champions League.
Barcelona have been just as sharp, beating Galatasaray 4-1 on October 13 after a 5-1 win over Feyenoord on September 9. Those back-to-back attacking displays suggest Barcelona are in good shape going into this trip to Paris. Raphinha, who had been injured, will start after recovering quicker than expected.
PSG confirmed lineup
Luis Enrique sends out PSG in a 4-3-3 with no absences to account for, giving him his strongest available group. Hakimi and Lucas Hernandez provide width from the back four, while Joao Neves, Vitinha and Fabian Ruiz form a midfield built to control possession and transition quickly. Up front, Dembele and Kvaratskhelia flank Doue, giving PSG pace and directness on both sides of the attack.
PSG confirmed starting XI (4-3-3): Matvey Safonov, Achraf Hakimi, Lucas Hernández, Vitinha, Marquinhos, Willian Pacho, João Neves, Fabián Ruiz, Ousmane Dembélé, Désiré Doué, Khvicha Kvaratskhelia. Coach: Luis Enrique Martínez García.
Barcelona confirmed lineup
Hansi Flick also lines Barcelona up in a 4-3-3, with a full squad to choose from and no absences listed. Pedri, Fermin Lopez and Marc Bernal anchor the midfield, tasked with feeding a front line that includes Lamine Yamal, Raphinha and Anthony Gordon. With Rodri sitting at the base of the defense alongside Cubarsi, Barcelona look set up to press high while keeping a settled, experienced spine behind the ball.
Barcelona confirmed starting XI (4-2-3-1): Joan García, João Cancelo, Xavi Espart, Pedri, Pau Cubarsí, Gerard Martín, Lamine Yamal, Marc Bernal, Raphinha, Dani Olmo, Anthony Gordon. Coach: Hansi Flick.

items.title: Why is Nuno Mendes not playing for PSG vs Barcelona in 2026-27 UEFA Champions League?
items.description:
Nuno Mendes will miss PSG’s Champions League clash with Barcelona after suffering a thigh injury, and Lucas Hernandez will start in his place. 
Nuno Mendes will not be part of the match for PSG as the defending champions host Barcelona in one of the biggest games of the Champions League league phase, and the reason is a muscle injury that came at the worst possible time for Luis Enrique.



The Portuguese left back suffered a left thigh injury in the 3-1 win at Strasbourg in Ligue 1 on Oct. 17, and medical tests the next day confirmed a muscle problem. PSG said in a statement that Mendes will be unavailable for the next few weeks, without giving a specific return date.



The injury came late in the game against Strasbourg, when Luis Enrique had already used all of his substitutions, so PSG had to finish the match with ten men. With Mendes out, Lucas Hernandez gets the start at left back in Paris, as PSG also deal with the absences of Senny Mayulu and Alessandro Longoni.



The loss is a blow for Luis Enrique as his team faces a Barcelona side that arrives with a perfect record. PSG have won both of their matches in the league phase, beating Slovan Bratislava 6-1 and winning 4-2 at Manchester City, while Barcelona have beaten Feyenoord 5-1 and Galatasaray 4-1, setting up one of the most anticipated matches of the league phase.




Medical Point Regarding Nuno Mendes@Aspetar👉 https://t.co/LuhhkABRAk pic.twitter.com/cwzMbMhJZU— Paris Saint-Germain (@PSG_English) October 18, 2026




Barcelona also arrive with injury concerns



PSG are not the only side dealing with absences in defense. Barcelona travel to Paris without Jules Kounde and Eric Garcia, who did not make the trip after picking up physical problems in the 5-2 win over Real Betis.


        


Garcia has a muscle injury in the right thigh and is expected to be out for three to four weeks, while Kounde suffered a sprained left ankle, and his recovery will also determine whether he is available for El Clasico against Real Madrid on Oct. 25.



Andreas Christensen is also out with a muscle injury in his left quadriceps and is not expected back until mid-November, while Roony Bardghji continues his recovery from a torn ACL in his right knee and is not expected to return until the final stretch of the season. The injuries leave Hansi Flick short of center backs, which makes Pau Cubarsi and Xavi Espart key pieces for the clash in Paris.

items.title: Why is Rodri not starting for Barcelona vs PSG in 2026-27 UEFA Champions League?
items.description:
Rodri will start on the bench for Barcelona against PSG, with Marc Bernal taking his place in midfield for the Champions League clash in Paris. 
Rodri won’t start for Barcelona against PSG in the Champions League league phase matchday three fixture at the Parc des Princes, but he has been named in Hansi Flick’s squad for the trip.



According to reports, Rodri was below his best in training and ended the session with muscle fatigue. It was described as a minor issue, not a serious injury, but enough for Flick to rest him as a precaution, especially with El Clasico against Real Madrid coming on Oct. 25, five days after the PSG game.



The defensive situation could also be a factor, as Barcelona travel without Jules Kounde, Eric Garcia and Andreas Christensen, which leaves Rodri as an emergency option from the bench if Flick needs one.



With Rodri on the bench, young midfielder Marc Bernal will take his place, while Frenkie de Jong, who has been called up for a second time after recovering from a long injury layoff, will also be an option from the bench for Flick.




𝐋𝐈𝐍𝐄 𝐔𝐏 ⭐️#PSGBarça | @championsleague pic.twitter.com/CseiKbxHg0— FC Barcelona (@FCBarcelona) October 20, 2026




Lineups confirmed



Raphinha returns to the starting lineup for this game after recovering from a muscle edema in the back of his right thigh. The Brazilian was included in the squad for the last LaLiga match against Real Betis, where he played 20 minutes, and now Flick will use him from the start against PSG.


        


Barcelona confirmed lineup: Joan Garcia; Cancelo, Cubarsi, Xavi Espart, Gerard Martin; Bernal, Pedri, Olmo; Yamal, Raphinha (C), Gordon.



On PSG’s side, Luis Enrique is without a key defender, as Nuno Mendes suffered a left thigh injury during the Ligue 1 match against Strasbourg and is ruled out against Barcelona.



PSG confirmed lineup: Safonov; Hakimi, Marquinhos (C), Pacho, Lucas Hernandez; Vitinha, Joao Neves, Fabian Ruiz; Doue, Dembele, Kvaratskhelia.

items.title: Liverpool vs Villarreal: Confirmed lineups for the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League match
items.description:
Take a look at the projected lineups for Liverpool vs Villarreal in the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League. Liverpool host Villarreal at Anfield in a Champions League fixture that carries real weight for both sides in the group phase.
Liverpool arrive on a two-game winning run that includes a 6-3 win over LASK on October 14 and a 2-1 win over Atlético back on September 9. Andoni Iraola’s side have shown they can score freely in Europe this season, and that attacking output has carried them through recent weeks. A win here would keep Liverpool firmly in control of their own group campaign.
Villarreal come into this match off a 3-1 win over Napoli on October 13, a result that followed a 2-3 loss to Dortmund on September 8. The bounce-back performance against Napoli suggests Iñigo Pérez’s group can respond well after a setback. Three points at Anfield would mark a statement result for Villarreal and strengthen their position in the group.
Liverpool confirmed lineup
Iraola’s projected 4-2-3-1 pairs Ryan Gravenberch alongside Jérémy Jacquet in midfield, with Florian Wirtz given freedom behind Lewis Koumas as the central attacking outlet. Bradley Barcola and Rio Ngumoha provide width from wide areas, while Treymaurice Nyoni’s inclusion points to squad depth being used across the forward line. Virgil Van Dijk and Joe Gómez anchor the back line in front of Alisson, giving Liverpool a settled defensive base to work from.
Liverpool confirmed starting XI (4-3-3): Alisson, Ronald Araujo, Jérémy Jacquet, Virgil Van Dijk, Kostas Tsimikas, Alexis Mac Allister, Treymaurice Nyoni, Ryan Gravenberch, Florian Wirtz, Lewis Koumas, Rio Ngumoha. Coach: Andoni Iraola.
Villarreal confirmed lineup
Iñigo Pérez sets Villarreal up in a straightforward 4-4-2, pairing Gerard Moreno with Georges Mikautadze up front to lead the attack. Santi Comesaña and Pape Gueye sit in central midfield, with Alberto Moleiro and Nathan Saliba tasked with supplying the front two from wide positions. Renato Veiga and Pau Navarro form the center of defense, giving the team a compact structure designed to stay organized against Liverpool’s movement.
Villarreal confirmed starting XI (4-2-1-3): Péter Gulácsi, Santiago Mouriño, Pau Navarro, Renato Veiga, Sergi Cardona, Santi Comesaña, Nathan Saliba, Pape Gueye, Tajon Buchanan, Georges Mikautadze, Alberto Moleiro. Coach: Iñigo Pérez.

items.title: Is Cristiano Ronaldo playing today? Confirmed lineups for Al Nassr vs Neom SC in 2026-27 Saudi Pro League Matchday 9
items.description:
Take a look at the projected lineups for Al Nassr vs Neom SC in the 2026-27 Saudi Pro League. Al Nassr host Neom SC in a Saudi Pro League fixture that pits a side chasing consistency against one still searching for rhythm in the final third.
Al Nassr enter on the back of a 3-0 win over Al Diriyah on October 9, a result that followed a 1-1 draw with Al Khaleej on September 12 and a 2-1 win over Abha on September 9. They have taken four points from their last two matches after that opening win, and three points here would keep them firmly in the title conversation. Postecoglou’s side will want to build on the attacking output from the Al Diriyah game rather than repeat the stalemate against Al Khaleej.
Neom SC arrive having lost 0-1 to Al-Ettifaq last Saturday, a result sandwiched between a 1-1 draw with Al Hazem on October 10 and a 4-2 win over Al Fateh FC back on September 13. The Al-Ettifaq defeat snapped whatever momentum they built from that high-scoring win in September, and they have managed just one point from their last two outings. A positive result at Al Nassr would steady a form line that has gone from free-scoring to stretched thin in recent weeks.
Al Nassr confirmed lineup
Postecoglou lines Al Nassr up in a 4-4-2 with Bento Krepski in goal behind a back four of Nawaf Al-Boushail, Mohamed Simakan, Iñigo Martínez and Awad Aman. Kingsley Coman and Samu provide the width in midfield, with Abdullah Al-Khaibari also in the engine room, while Sadio Mané, João Félix and Cristiano Ronaldo are all named in attacking positions. That gives the hosts three recognized forwards to rotate around a front two, suggesting fluid interchange rather than a fixed strike partnership. With no absences listed, this looks close to a full-strength selection for Al Nassr.
Al Nassr confirmed starting XI (4-4-2): Bento, Nawaf Bu Washl, Aiman Yahya, Abdullah Al Khaibari, Abdulelah Al Amri, Iñigo Martínez, Samú Costa, Ângelo, Cristiano Ronaldo, João Félix, Sadio Mané. Coach: Ange Postecoglou.
Neom SC confirmed lineup
Christophe Galtier also sets Neom SC up in a 4-4-2, with Marcin Bulka in goal and a back line of Khalifah Al-Dawsari, Malang Sarr, Nathan Zézé and Hawsawi Ahmed. Giorgos Masouras and Abdulmalik Al-Oyayari flank a central midfield pairing of Valentín Vada and Mohannad Abu Taha, feeding a front two of Alexandre Lacazette and Saïd Benrahma. That pairing gives Neom SC a direct scoring outlet after a lean spell in front of goal. No absences are listed, so Galtier can call on his intended first-choice group for this trip to Al Nassr.
Neom SC confirmed starting XI (4-4-2): Marcin Bulka, Mohammed Al Burayk, Mohammed Al Dossary, Abdulmalik Al Oyayari, Malang Sarr, Nathan Zézé, Khalil Al Absi, Abbas Al Hassan, Saïd Benrahma, Alexandre Lacazette, Mohannad Abu Taha. Coach: Thierry Oleksiak.

items.title: Nashville on the brink of Supporters’ Shield as Lionel Messi’s Inter Miami run out of road
items.description:
Nashville SC are closing in on the Supporters’ Shield, and Inter Miami’s hopes of stopping them, even with Lionel Messi in the form of his life, are all but gone. With four games left in the MLS regular season, the Tennesseans are one result away from being crowned, while Miami can only look on. Nashville […] 
Nashville SC are closing in on the Supporters’ Shield, and Inter Miami’s hopes of stopping them, even with Lionel Messi in the form of his life, are all but gone. With four games left in the MLS regular season, the Tennesseans are one result away from being crowned, while Miami can only look on.



Nashville missed a chance to clinch the trophy on Oct. 17, when they drew 1-1 at San Jose and delayed their celebrations. Even so, they have 67 points, 12 more than second-place Inter Miami, and they can seal the Shield with a win, or even a draw, in any of their four remaining matches.



Miami, for their part, did what they could by beating Atlanta United 3-1 to reach 55 points. However, they can no longer fight for the title. A perfect finish would take the defending MLS Cup champions to 67 points at most, only level with Nashville, and the first tiebreaker in the standings is total wins. Miami have 15 victories, and even with four more they would reach 19, while Nashville already have 20.



That leaves Messi’s remarkable season without the trophy that once looked within reach. The Argentine star scored twice against Atlanta to reach 25 goals this year, and he has scored or assisted in each of his last 12 MLS matches.




Two stunning goals. One extraordinary Messi. 🎩Here’s your #IconOfTheMatch for tonight! 🏆✨ @RoyalCaribbean pic.twitter.com/Am9C4hTiR3— Inter Miami CF (@InterMiamiCF) October 18, 2026




Inter Miami prepare to defend their MLS Cup title



While the Supporters’ Shield is out of reach, Inter Miami are already looking ahead to the playoffs, where they will defend the MLS Cup they won in 2025. 


        


As things stand in the Eastern Conference table, the defending champions are second with 55 points, which would give them a first-round matchup against seventh-placed Orlando City and their star signing Antoine Griezmann.



The pairing would be a best-of-three series, a new format for 2026, with the first game at Miami’s stadium. Orlando have 41 points and are five points clear of the eighth-place group, so both sides still have standings to protect. The final matchups will not be set until the regular season ends on Nov. 7.

items.title: Ronald Araujo addresses permanent Liverpool transfer option following Barcelona loan
items.description:
Ronald Araujo has established himself as a vital defensive asset for Liverpool since completing his season-long loan switch from Barcelona in August, sparking mounting speculation that the Premier League club is preparing to trigger the permanent buy option. 
Ronald Araujo was sent on loan to Liverpool from Barcelona this season. The defender has enjoyed a solid campaign so far, fueling speculation among supporters that the Reds will trigger their purchase option to prevent him from returning to La Liga next summer.



Araujo was once hailed as the long-term pillar of Barcelona’s defense. However, a string of high-profile errors invited fierce criticism from fans and the media, and the mounting pressure took a toll on his consistency for the Blaugrana in pivotal moments.



As a result, Barcelona opted to loan him to Liverpool, offering him an elite environment in the Premier League to rebuild his confidence and sharpness. Now that he is producing consistent performances, reports suggest the Merseyside club could be keen on signing him permanently—a scenario the Uruguayan insists is far too early to consider.



“It’s very early,” Araujo said on a potential permanent transfer to Liverpool. “I’m just trying to enjoy every day, continue to grow and develop every day to have that confidence. I’m really happy to be here, me and my family too.”



A loan was the best thing that happened to Araujo



While a significant portion of the campaign remains ahead, Araujo is already demonstrating his quality as a top-tier center-back who may have suffered from undue scrutiny and impatience in Catalonia. Away from the Camp Nou spotlight, the loan spell appears to be exactly what his career needed.



Ronald Araujo playing for Barcelona.


        


Should he maintain this level of success with Liverpool, the Reds are expected to give serious thought to activating the purchase option included in his contract. On the other hand, if financial considerations prompt Liverpool to pass on the option, returning to Barcelona in peak physical and mental form could give Araujo the platform to reclaim his status as an undisputed starter in Spain.



His technical and physical attributes have never been in doubt. Maintaining mental resilience and consistency under pressure has been his primary challenge, making it vital for Araujo to block out transfer speculation, sustain his focus on the pitch, and re-establish his standing among the world’s premier central defenders.

items.title: Vitinha outlines PSG’s plan to contain Barcelona, Lamine Yamal in Champions League clash
items.description:
Paris Saint-Germain face one of their most demanding tests of the 2026–27 UEFA Champions League campaign on Tuesday as they host FC Barcelona, with global attention centered on how the Parisian back line will handle 19-year-old sensation Lamine Yamal. 
There is no doubt that the marquee fixture in the UEFA Champions League this week is the clash between Paris Saint-Germain and Barcelona. Lamine Yamal faces a formidable test at the Parc des Princes, but the French champions are well prepared to counter the talented left-footed winger.



Vitinha is set to feature prominently in the lineup tasked with containing Yamal. Nevertheless, the Portuguese midfielder stressed that PSG cannot afford to focus solely on the Spanish sensation, warning that reducing Barcelona to a single player would be a mistake given the Blaugrana’s star-studded squad and dominant recent form.



“To be honest, I would not say fear. He’s a great player, one of the best in the world,” Vitinha said when asked if PSG should fear Yamal. “What he’s doing is incredible. He’s special, but tomorrow we’ll be facing a great team, not just Lamine Yamal.”



A legendary clash awaits



Barcelona and PSG share a storied, tempestuous rivalry in recent years—not only through dramatic knockout encounters, but also via high-profile departures. Multiple stars, most notably Lionel Messi and Neymar, have left the Catalan club to join the Ligue 1 giants in search of new financial terms or more ambitious sporting projects.



Vitinha lifting the UCL trophy



Supporters of both clubs are acutely aware of that simmering tension, which lends this match immense psychological weight. Furthermore, both sides are regarded as premier contenders for the trophy this season, meaning the outcome in Paris could shape the trajectory of the league phase and have direct consequences on knockout-stage seeding.


        


The fixture also pits two tactical masterminds against each other, with Hansi Flick and Luis Enrique widely recognized among the world’s elite managers. Determining who can dictate tempo and dominate the midfield battle across the full 90 minutes will be decisive in securing three crucial points on Europe’s biggest stage.

items.title: Will that do? Lamine Yamal conjures another magical spell as Barça pass first test | Sid Lowe
items.description: The 19-year-old scored a cracker in Seville, days after his ‘almost rabona’ at Galatasaray, as La Liga leaders beat Real BetisWhen at last it was time for Lamine Yamal to leave, the 19-year-old’s number going up before the 90th minute for only the second time since the opening day, Real Betis fans whistled him all the way to the touchline where Barcelona’s coach was waiting. His work here was done, Hansi Flick invited him to take the weight off his feet and his shoulders, not that he wanted to. First, though, he took Lamine Yamal’s head in his hands and, leaning in away from the amateur lip readers, tried to make himself heard over the noise. “I told him I was proud of him because he played a fantastic game,” he said.At least he could think of something. When Lamine Yamal had opened the scoring just nine minutes into the match that was supposed to find out how good Barcelona really were, it hadn’t been easy. Nothing erudite, anyway. On the morning that Barcelona went to Betis – first v third, a proper opponent at last – Jorge Valdano had lamented that sometimes he doesn’t have the words, and he always has the words. Valdano had just watched Lamine do that, whatever that was, in Istanbul – an “almost rabona”, the kid called it – and now he had a problem. “If he keeps doing strange things, we’re not going to be able to explain it,” he wrote. items.title: Brighton are the apex B club – their next target should be a Champions League place | Jonathan Wilson
items.description: Diego Gómez’s wondergoal in a five-star demolition is just the latest in an impressive run of results for the south coast teamSign up for our free newsletter hereFor two or three years now, it’s been standard to nod approvingly at how well-run Brighton, Brentford and Bournemouth are, and to move on. What else is there to say? It’s true, of course – these are sides who have made the most of relatively limited resources. But there’s also an underlying assumption in the designation: that these are clubs who have no higher aspiration, that their limit is earning praise for upper mid-table finishes.This season, perhaps, offers an opportunity to change that. Other than Arsenal, every major club is undergoing significant transition. Manchester City may have started the season with seven straight wins, but there’s every chance the punishment for their multiple breaches of Premier League regulations takes them out of the race for the top five. In that context, why shouldn’t one of those efficient smaller sides qualify for the Champions League? Continue reading...

items.description: Another round of games and another disappointing draw for Arsenal while Manchester City sit top of the table with a 100% recordThere would have been hope that the international break could offer the Arsenal players and staff a reset but the same problems reared their head at the Emirates on Sunday in a 1-1 draw with Birmingham. As they have done so often this season, the Gunners dominated most attacking and possession-based metrics – they registered 76% possession, a 2.73 xG and 43 touches in the opposition box – but their profligacy in front of goal and lack of urgency in their play once again came to the fore. Of their 27 chances, they managed just four on target as they toiled against a resilient opposition who understood the playbook. Birmingham set up in a strong defensive structure, protecting their box admirably with numbers to frustrate Renée Slegers’s side, who famously struggle to break down low blocks. items.title: Is Kylian Mbappe playing today? Confirmed lineups for Real Madrid vs Sevilla in 2026-27 LaLiga season Matchday 9
items.description:
Take a look at the projected lineups for Real Madrid vs Sevilla in the 2026-27 LaLiga. Real Madrid and Sevilla meet in the 2026-27 LaLiga season in a crucial match for both squads, as the top teams in the standings have already won their duels. Here are the projected lineups.
Real Madrid come in off a win against Villarreal (1-0). They won their UEFA Champions League match against Roma in an epic 4-3 comeback, receiving a big boost for their return to LaLiga.
Sevilla come in off a draw against Levante (3-3). They are currently in 5th position in the standings, but a win could send them to the 4th position, which is currently being hold by Real Madrid.
Real Madrid confirmed lineup
Real Madrid line up in a 4-2-3-1. Ferland Mendy is unavailable. However, Kylian Mbappe is completely healthy and is set to start for Los Blancos in this key duel.
Real Madrid confirmed starting XI (4-2-3-1): Thibaut Courtois, Federico Valverde, Marc Cucurella, Aurélien Tchouaméni, Ibrahima Konaté, Dean Huijsen, Endrick, Jude Bellingham, Kylian Mbappé, Arda Güler, Yan Diomande. Coach: José Mário dos Santos Mourinho Félix.
Sevilla confirmed lineup
Sevilla line up in a 4-2-3-1. Miguel Sierra is unavailable.
Sevilla confirmed starting XI (4-2-3-1): Odysseas Vlachodimos, Juan Iglesias, Gabriel Suazo, Youssouf Fofana, Andrés Castrín, Kike Salas, Rubén Vargas, Lucien Agoumé, Robbie Ure, Peque Fernández, Félix Correia. Coach: Luis García.

items.title: Lionel Messi reaches 936 career goals at age 39: How his tally stacks up against Cristiano Ronaldo
items.description:
With a brace against Atlanta United, Lionel Messi reached 936 career goals at 39 years old, but how many did Cristiano Ronaldo have at the same age? 
Following his two-goal performance in Inter Miami’s 3–1 victory over Atlanta United, Lionel Messi reached 936 career goals at age 39. How many did Cristiano Ronaldo have at the same age?



Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo are undoubtedly two of the greatest soccer players in history. They continue to make history game after game, leaving many supporters wondering how their legendary careers will ultimately conclude.



On Saturday, Lionel Messi scored a brace against Atlanta United to lead Inter Miami to a 3–1 victory, reaching 936 career goals. Compared to Cristiano Ronaldo’s output at the exact same age, the Argentine forward is on pace to finish his career with more goals than the Portuguese icon.



How many goals did Cristiano Ronaldo have at 39 years old?



When Cristiano Ronaldo celebrated his 39th birthday on February 5, 2024, he had accumulated 873 official career goals across 1,204 appearances. By the end of his 39th year—when he turned 40 on February 5, 2025—Ronaldo had increased his total to 923 career goals in 1,254 matches after netting 50 goals across that 12-month span.



Cristiano Ronaldo of Al Nassr.



Lionel Messi turned 39 on June 24, 2026, with 916 career goals to his name—nearly matching the total Ronaldo had accumulated when he turned 40. Messi has since added 20 more goals to reach 936, with roughly eight months and numerous fixtures remaining before he celebrates his 40th birthday.


        


A key differentiator moving forward is their international availability. Lionel Messi has already retired from the Argentina national team, reducing the number of matches available to him. As a result, he can now only build on his tally through domestic and continental competitions with Inter Miami.



The road to 1,000 goals



Cristiano Ronaldo currently stands just 19 goals away from scoring 1,000 career goals. He is widely projected to reach and potentially surpass that milestone, depending on how much longer he decides to continue playing.



Even without fixtures for the Argentina national team, Lionel Messi remains on pace to also reach 1,000 career goals. While he is currently further away than Cristiano Ronaldo, Messi is more than two years younger and maintains a superior career goals-per-game ratio, keeping the race for the ultimate scoring milestone firmly open.

items.title: Is Christian Pulisic playing today? Confirmed lineups for AC Milan vs Atalanta in 2026-27 Serie A season Matchday 7
items.description:
Take a look at the projected lineups for AC Milan vs Atalanta in the 2026-27 Serie A and if Christian Pulisic will play for the Rossoneri today. AC Milan host Atalanta at San Siro in a Serie A clash between two clubs looking to find consistency in the table. The big question remaining is: will Christian Pulisic start today?
AC Milan come into this one unbeaten in their last two outings, drawing 1-1 with Sassuolo on October 11 after a 3-0 win over Lecce on September 20, with a 2-2 draw against Lazio on September 12 also in the mix.
Atalanta arrive off the back of a 3-1 win over Venezia FC on October 12, a result that followed back-to-back defeats, a 0-2 loss to Juventus on September 20 and a 1-2 defeat to Cagliari on September 12.
AC Milan confirmed lineup
Ruben Amorim sends out AC Milan in a 4-4-2 with Mike Maignan behind a back four of Mario Gila, Koni De Winter, Strahinja Pavlovic and Pervis Estupinan. Luka Modric and Adrien Rabiot anchor the midfield, with Samuel Chukwueze and Diego Moreira providing width, while Christian Pulisic links play behind strike partner Goncalo Ramos. There are no absences listed for AC Milan, so Amorim has his full projected group available for this one.
AC Milan confirmed starting XI (4-4-2): Mike Maignan, Mario Gila, Koni De Winter, Strahinja Pavlovic, Yunus Musah, Samuel Chukwueze, Luka Modric, Adrien Rabiot, Diego Moreira, Christian Pulisic, Goncalo Ramos. Coach: Ruben Amorim.
Atalanta confirmed lineup
Maurizio Sarri lines Atalanta up in a 4-2-3-1, with Marco Carnesecchi in goal protected by Davide Zappacosta, Thomas Kristensen, Sead Kolasinac and Lorenzo Bernasconi. Gianluca Gaetano and Lazar Samardzic sit as the double pivot, with Ederson Silva, Charles De Ketelaere and Jon Rowe operating behind lone striker Nikola Krstovic. Atalanta have no absences listed, leaving Sarri with his intended personnel for the trip to San Siro.
Atalanta confirmed starting XI (4-2-3-1): Marco Carnesecchi, Raoul Bellanova, Thomas Kristensen, Sead Kolasinac, Lorenzo Bernasconi, Mario Pasalic, Lazar Samardzic, Ederson Silva, Charles De Ketelaere, Nikola Krstovic, Jon Rowe. Coach: Maurizio Sarri.
